decisions.dwg_authority: The embedded DWG is authoritative for sheets, views, view curves and annotations. Fusion does not regenerate it from the entity segments.
decisions.view_recompute: Fusion shows the view curves stored in the DWG on open. It recomputes them from the referenced body when updateAllReferences updates an out-of-date reference (D2NoViewCurves, E7StaleBrep, E8StaleRevision, M1 edit).
decisions.dwg_writer: ReadDwgFile and EmitDwgFile decode and re-emit the A0, A1 and A2 controls and the historical DWG byte for byte from typed values.
decisions.authoring: AuthorDwg, BuildDrawing and BuildBundle build a drawing-root F3Z from typed inputs with no source DWG bytes. Fusion 2706.1.17 did not finish opening any Kit-authored DWG.
decisions.header_shorts: Fusion checks the four BS values after the header handle stream. They depend on the header variables: changing USERR4 (B8UserReal) or VERSIONGUID (B1VersionGuid) with the A1 values kept stalled the open. They do not depend on objects, the handle map, classes or the other sections. No unkeyed CRC, Adler, digest or seeded PRNG over the header bytes reproduces them in 31 Fusion saves. Kit does not copy or imitate Fusion-written values in authored files.
decisions.trusted_dwg: Kit never writes the Autodesk trusted-file AppInfo entry or another product's AppInfo, because that text states an Autodesk save. Fusion stalls when neither AppInfo nor AppInfoHistory carries that text (C1AppNoTrust, C7AppOnly), and opens with it (C2AppKitProduct). W1KitAppInfo opened only because its AppInfoHistory still carried the text.
